career_ladder.note: Recruitment through the UKSSSC Intermediate Level Examination feeds into Group 'C' ministerial, clerical, and revenue collection cadres across district collectorates, commissioner offices, and state government directorates in Uttarakhand. Hierarchical progression follows the Uttarakhand Clerical Cadre (Collectorate and Subordinate Offices) Service Rules up to administrative officership.

exam_scheme.note: The examination scheme for Junior Assistant and Intermediate Level posts is officially approved by the Government of Uttarakhand Personnel and Vigilance Department vide Order No. 426610/XXX(4)/2026-03(03)/26-E-94441 dated 25 August 2026. The selection process comprises a single 100-mark written test followed by a compulsory qualifying typing examination (minimum 4,000 key depressions per hour in Hindi) for candidates in a 4:1 vacancy ratio.

financial_package.note: Junior Assistants, Data Entry Operators, and Tax Collectors recruited through UKSSSC Intermediate Level examinations are placed in Pay Level 3 (₹21,700 - ₹69,100) under the Uttarakhand State Revised Pay Rules (adapting 7th Pay Commission). Entry basic pay is ₹21,700.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UKSSSC Intermediate Level Post Specifications & Uttarakhand State Pay Rules
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary calculated on Level 3 Entry Basic Pay of ₹21,700 with Dearness Allowance at canonical 58% (₹12,586), House Rent Allowance between 9% (₹1,953 in rural/tehsil offices) to 18% (₹3,906 in Dehradun and major municipal stations), Fixed Medical Allowance (₹1,000/month), and admissible Hill Compensatory Allowance (HCA) for designated hill stations. Net in-hand estimate accounts for statutory NPS deduction of 10% on Basic + DA (₹3,429) and state group insurance (~₹200).
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (HRA) ranging from 9% to 18% based on station classification, or government clerical housing
Hill Compensatory Allowance (HCA) admissible for notified mountain districts and border stations
Fixed Medical Allowance (FMA) of ₹1,000/month or comprehensive coverage under Uttarakhand State Health Schemes (USHS)
Contributory pension coverage under the National Pension System (NPS)
Annual increment of 3% as per Uttarakhand Revised Pay Rules
Standard state civil leave entitlements (Casual, Earned, Medical Leave)
